scientific_integrity: Finite rational checks supplement but do not replace an all-size proof. Earliest focal day-verified preprint is arXiv:1310.2592v1 dated 2013-10-09; earlier mathematical background is cited but the 2006 conference date is not asserted to establish its precise first public-release day. First-order wheel optimization and the second-order spectral trace metric were known separately. Priority is qualified, and independent audit is unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Only simple undirected wheels under a unit continuous conductance budget with connected positive support; only the first and second inverse Laplacian spectral traces. No directed, discrete-time, price-heterogeneous or discrete-leader claims.
title: A seven-rim reversal between first- and second-order coherence-optimal wheel conductances
